permissions.title: Permissions for {user}
permissions.is_admin: This user is an administrator: full access to everything, regardless of this table.
permissions.hint: Granting any permission also grants “View”. Click a column header or a module name to toggle them all.
permissions.inherited_hint: Marks the permissions the user already has through their groups; the ones in this table are added to them.
permissions.group_hint: Users in this group get these permissions in addition to their own.
